reuse.why: It writes a private getExpectedScheduleAmount instead of calling the existing exported getScheduledAmount in shared/schedules.ts, which already covers missing, numeric and ranged amounts.

duplication.why: The missing/number/range dispatch and the furthest-from-zero comparison duplicate getScheduledAmount. The copy also drifts from it: a strict `>` tie-break and no rounding.

placement.why: Adding the field in scheduleModel.toExternal fits the API mapping layer, but the amount rule itself is placed in api-models instead of the shared schedules module.

scope.why: Only the new field, its type and a test.

maintainability.why: A second definition of 'expected amount' will diverge from the one planning uses, which is exactly the inconsistency the request wants scripts to avoid.

disguised_duplication.where: getExpectedScheduleAmount in api-models.ts restates getScheduledAmount under a new name, with slightly reshaped null and tie handling.
